parameters.query: SELECT s.*, l.name as location_name, l.address, l.contact_name, l.contact_phone FROM plotops.scenes s LEFT JOIN plotops.scene_locations sl ON s.id = sl.scene_id LEFT JOIN plotops.locations l ON sl.location_id = l.id WHERE s.id = $1

SELECT c.*, a.first_name, a.last_name, a.phone FROM plotops.scene_characters sc JOIN plotops.characters c ON sc.character_id = c.id LEFT JOIN plotops.character_casting cc ON c.id = cc.character_id LEFT JOIN plotops.actors a ON cc.actor_id = a.id WHERE sc.scene_id = $1
